{"people":[{"name":"Sam","role":"account executive (rep)","side":"us"},{"name":"PMM","role":"interviewer","side":"us"},{"name":"Lucy","role":"ecommerce director, champion","side":"customer"},{"name":"Martin","role":"CFO, final decision maker","side":"customer"},{"name":"the controller","role":"built the one-page rate comparison for Martin","side":"customer"},{"name":"their IT lead","role":"IT lead, nervous about moving before spring","side":"customer"},{"name":"Farah","role":"solutions engineer","side":"us"},{"name":"the bank","role":"Fernbrook's bank, Fiserv processing provider that sharpened its rate","side":"competitor"}],
"competitors":["Fiserv (through their bank)"],
"incumbent":"Fiserv through their bank",
"evidence":[
{"id":"E1","turn":2,"excerpt":"Their ecommerce director, Lucy, came inbound.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Inbound lead from the ecommerce director, who became the champion."},
{"id":"E2","turn":2,"excerpt":"She said about one in twelve online orders was failing at the payment step, and it was worse on the big baskets.","label":"fact","speaker":"Lucy (relayed by rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Customer-reported failure rate, concentrated in large orders."},
{"id":"E3","turn":2,"excerpt":"Customers would call in annoyed, or just not come back.","label":"fact","speaker":"Lucy (relayed by rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Business impact of failed orders: complaints and lost customers."},
{"id":"E4","turn":2,"excerpt":"And she couldn't get a straight answer from the processor on why.","label":"fact","speaker":"Lucy (relayed by rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger","competitor"],"note":"Incumbent processor gave no explanation for the declines."},
{"id":"E5","turn":4,"excerpt":"Her number. Off their own dashboard.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"The one-in-twelve figure came from the customer's own dashboard."},
{"id":"E6","turn":6,"excerpt":"Martin said no. Lucy told me. I never met him.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","decided"],"note":"CFO decision known only secondhand through Lucy; rep never met Martin."},
{"id":"E7","turn":6,"excerpt":"Lucy was the champion, she wanted it, IT was fine with it.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Champion wanted it; IT described as fine with it."},
{"id":"E8","turn":8,"excerpt":"Lucy said he doesn't take vendor meetings and she'd carry it.","label":"fact","speaker":"Lucy (relayed by rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","gaps"],"note":"Decider was unreachable; the champion carried the case alone."},
{"id":"E9","turn":10,"excerpt":"They were on Fiserv through their bank, had been forever.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Incumbent is Fiserv via the bank, long-standing."},
{"id":"E10","turn":10,"excerpt":"What Lucy told me is that when the bank heard, they came back and sharpened the rate.","label":"fact","speaker":"Lucy (relayed by rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Bank responded with a better rate once it learned of the evaluation."},
{"id":"E11","turn":12,"excerpt":"Up to then Lucy was asking about declines.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","message"],"note":"Early questions focused on declines."},
{"id":"E12","turn":12,"excerpt":"After the bank came back, every email was the rate.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","decided"],"note":"Customer questions shifted entirely to rate after the bank's counter."},
{"id":"E13","turn":14,"excerpt":"Lucy loved the checkout. And the decline piece.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Positive reaction to checkout and decline messaging."},
{"id":"E14","turn":14,"excerpt":"Lucy was nodding the whole way.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Lucy's reaction to Farah's explanation of big-ticket declines."},
{"id":"E15","turn":14,"excerpt":"Silence, honestly, nothing bombed.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Rep did not name any pitch part that got silence."},
{"id":"E16","turn":14,"excerpt":"It was a good cycle. We lost on price.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome","decided"],"note":"Rep's summary: lost, on price."},
{"id":"E17","turn":16,"excerpt":"he's not going to pay more for the same thing.","label":"quote","speaker":"Lucy (relaying Martin)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","language"],"note":"Lucy's words after meeting Martin; the first sign of loss."},
{"id":"E18","turn":16,"excerpt":"Right before that she'd been telling me it was a formality.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","decider"],"note":"Champion expected approval; the champion's read was wrong."},
{"id":"E19","turn":18,"excerpt":"Their rate with the bank. The controller did a one-pager for Martin. Our rate, their rate, side by side.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","gaps"],"note":"Controller's side-by-side rate page was the decision document."},
{"id":"E20","turn":20,"excerpt":"The per-transaction number.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Only the per-transaction rate line was compared."},
{"id":"E21","turn":20,"excerpt":"Which isn't fair, because they pay a gateway fee on top, and they've got a person who does nothing but chargebacks.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decided"],"note":"Rep thinks the comparison omitted gateway fee and chargeback labor costs."},
{"id":"E22","turn":20,"excerpt":"But that's not on the statement line, so it wasn't on the page.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Total-cost items were absent from the comparison page."},
{"id":"E23","turn":22,"excerpt":"Our quote.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Only our quote from us was on the page."},
{"id":"E24","turn":24,"excerpt":"Martin and the controller. I wasn't in the room. Lucy presented it.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","gaps"],"note":"Rep absent from the decisive meeting; Lucy presented."},
{"id":"E25","turn":24,"excerpt":"Why would I pay more for the same thing.","label":"quote","speaker":"Martin (relayed by Lucy, then rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","language"],"note":"Decider saw no differentiation; wording differs from T16."},
{"id":"E26","turn":26,"excerpt":"Which it isn't.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","gaps"],"note":"Rep disputes the 'same thing' view but did not get it across."},
{"id":"E27","turn":28,"excerpt":"We showed the uplift slide. The average improvement in acceptance.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","gaps"],"note":"Value shown was a generic average, not Fernbrook-specific."},
{"id":"E28","turn":30,"excerpt":"Not in a doc, no.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"No Fernbrook-specific value figure was documented."},
{"id":"E29","turn":30,"excerpt":"Farah offered to run their declines. She wanted a three-month export so she could show what the failed orders were worth.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Our SE offered a quantification that was never done."},
{"id":"E30","turn":30,"excerpt":"I didn't want to slow things down. Lucy was sold. I didn't think we needed it.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Rep's reason for skipping the export: quarter-end speed, champion already sold."},
{"id":"E31","turn":32,"excerpt":"Nothing from us.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decided"],"note":"Martin had nothing from us on the cost of failed orders."},
{"id":"E32","turn":32,"excerpt":"I assume Lucy told him.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decider"],"note":"Unverified assumption that the cost was conveyed to Martin."},
{"id":"E33","turn":34,"excerpt":"Yes. Probably.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome","decided"],"note":"Hedged belief that matching price would have won."},
{"id":"E34","turn":34,"excerpt":"their IT lead was a bit nervous about moving before spring, that's their whole year. He'd said he'd do it if finance approved.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep (IT lead's statement relayed)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","decided"],"note":"IT had timing concerns, conditional on finance."},
{"id":"E35","turn":34,"excerpt":"And Martin would still have been looking at a page that said same rate, so why move.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","gaps"],"note":"Rep concedes price match alone may not have won."},
{"id":"E36","turn":34,"excerpt":"So maybe not only the rate. But the rate is what killed it.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome","decided"],"note":"Self-hedge, then reasserts rate as cause."},
{"id":"E37","turn":36,"excerpt":"Lucy asked once if we had something she could hand Martin. Like a one-page business case.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Champion requested a business case for the CFO."},
{"id":"E38","turn":36,"excerpt":"I sent her the deck and the pricing proposal.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Response to the request was existing materials, not a business case."},
{"id":"E39","turn":38,"excerpt":"The customer stories. The average uplift.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","message"],"note":"The deck's 'business case' was generic stories and averages."},
{"id":"E40","turn":40,"excerpt":"orders dying at the last step.","label":"quote","speaker":"Lucy","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","trigger"],"note":"Customer's own phrase for the problem."},
{"id":"E41","turn":40,"excerpt":"the big baskets.","label":"quote","speaker":"Lucy","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","trigger"],"note":"Customer's term for large orders."},
{"id":"E42","turn":40,"excerpt":"we do all the work to get someone to buy a four-thousand-dollar greenhouse and then the card says no.","label":"quote","speaker":"Lucy","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","trigger"],"note":"Vivid customer framing of the cost of failed payments."},
{"id":"E43","turn":40,"excerpt":"the same thing.","label":"quote","speaker":"Martin (secondhand)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","decided"],"note":"Only Martin phrase the rep has, secondhand."},
{"id":"E44","turn":42,"excerpt":"If we'd had more room on the rate, we win this.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome","decided"],"note":"Rep's counterfactual: a lower rate wins."}
],
"contradictions":[
{"evidence":["E7","E34"],"what":"Rep says IT was fine with it, but later reveals the IT lead was nervous about moving before spring and conditional on finance approval."},
{"evidence":["E16","E35","E36"],"what":"Rep says they lost on price and the rate killed it, but also concedes Martin would still see 'same rate' and maybe not only the rate."},
{"evidence":["E30","E37"],"what":"Rep says Lucy was sold and no value figure was needed, yet Lucy asked for something to hand Martin and was sent only generic materials."},
{"evidence":["E18","E6"],"what":"Lucy called approval a formality right before Martin said no, so the champion's read of the decider was wrong."},
{"evidence":["E17","E25"],"what":"Martin's words are rendered differently ('he's not going to pay more for the same thing' vs 'Why would I pay more for the same thing'), although rep says it is the same."},
{"evidence":["E31","E32","E24"],"what":"Rep says Martin got nothing from us on the cost of failed orders, then assumes Lucy conveyed it, though rep was not in the room."},
{"evidence":["E16","E26","E21"],"what":"Rep calls it 'a good cycle' lost on price while saying the comparison was unfair and 'same thing' is wrong, which points to a value-communication gap."}
],
"dodges":[
{"question":"Which part of our pitch got a reaction, and which got silence?","turn":13,"what":"Rep named only positive reactions, then said 'Silence, honestly, nothing bombed' without naming any silent part."},
{"question":"Did we put a figure on the value they'd get? / A figure for Fernbrook.","turn":27,"what":"Rep first cited the generic uplift slide; admitted only on a second ask that no Fernbrook figure existed."},
{"question":"What did Martin have in front of him about what one in twelve orders was costing?","turn":31,"what":"Rep paused ('...'), said 'Nothing from us,' then speculated that Lucy told him."},
{"question":"What did they ask for that we couldn't show?","turn":35,"what":"Rep described a request for a business case but framed it as sending the deck; did not say we could not show it."},
{"question":"If we had matched the price, would we have won? What else would have needed to be true?","turn":33,"what":"Rep answered 'Yes. Probably,' then listed other obstacles, then returned to the rate."}
],
"skipped":[],
"language_pairs":[
{"theirs":"orders dying at the last step","ours":"declines / acceptance","evidence":["E40","E11","E27"]},
{"theirs":"the big baskets","ours":"big-ticket orders","evidence":["E41","E14"]},
{"theirs":"the same thing","ours":"uplift in acceptance / the decline piece","evidence":["E25","E43","E27"]},
{"theirs":"the card says no","ours":"declines","evidence":["E42","E11"]}
],
"outcome_signals":[
{"evidence":["E16","E44"],"what":"Rep reports the deal as lost, attributing it to price/rate."},
{"evidence":["E6","E17","E25"],"what":"CFO Martin said no; the decision was relayed secondhand through Lucy."},
{"evidence":["E10","E12"],"what":"After the bank sharpened its rate, customer focus shifted from declines to rate, and the customer stayed with the incumbent. No partial move was mentioned."},
{"evidence":["E33","E34","E35","E36"],"what":"Rep is hedged on whether a price match would have won; IT timing and the lack of a value case also appear."}
]}

contradictions.what: Rep says IT was fine with it, but later reveals the IT lead was nervous about moving before spring and conditional on finance approval.
Rep says they lost on price and the rate killed it, but also concedes Martin would still see 'same rate' and maybe not only the rate.
Rep says Lucy was sold and no value figure was needed, yet Lucy asked for something to hand Martin and was sent only generic materials.
Lucy called approval a formality right before Martin said no, so the champion's read of the decider was wrong.
Martin's words are rendered differently ('he's not going to pay more for the same thing' vs 'Why would I pay more for the same thing'), although rep says it is the same.
Rep says Martin got nothing from us on the cost of failed orders, then assumes Lucy conveyed it, though rep was not in the room.
Rep calls it 'a good cycle' lost on price while saying the comparison was unfair and 'same thing' is wrong, which points to a value-communication gap.

dodges.question: Which part of our pitch got a reaction, and which got silence?
dodges.what: Rep named only positive reactions, then said 'Silence, honestly, nothing bombed' without naming any silent part.

dodges.question: Did we put a figure on the value they'd get? / A figure for Fernbrook.
dodges.what: Rep first cited the generic uplift slide; admitted only on a second ask that no Fernbrook figure existed.

dodges.question: What did Martin have in front of him about what one in twelve orders was costing?
dodges.what: Rep paused ('...'), said 'Nothing from us,' then speculated that Lucy told him.

dodges.question: What did they ask for that we couldn't show?
dodges.what: Rep described a request for a business case but framed it as sending the deck; did not say we could not show it.

dodges.question: If we had matched the price, would we have won? What else would have needed to be true?
dodges.what: Rep answered 'Yes. Probably,' then listed other obstacles, then returned to the rate.

outcome_signals.what: Rep reports the deal as lost, attributing it to price/rate.
CFO Martin said no; the decision was relayed secondhand through Lucy.
After the bank sharpened its rate, customer focus shifted from declines to rate, and the customer stayed with the incumbent. No partial move was mentioned.
Rep is hedged on whether a price match would have won; IT timing and the lack of a value case also appear.
